mandate: Owner ruling after the 2026-08-17 black-belt adjudication panel: 'spot fix the 10 worst offenders and defer four or five hours to fix everything else with a calibration wave.' This is that wave. position_type WORDS were settled by the panel and were not touched; attempt_probability maps (Q3 occurrence calibration) and outcome probabilities (success-rate calibration) are owned elsewhere and were not touched.

scope.note_on_exclusions: the 10 owner-approved spot fixes of v1.106.3 were excluded as instructed

method.principle: Case by case, as a black belt would: each role was read against its own authored word, description, state invariants and — decisively — its own transition list, then placed against the SETTLED corpus rather than against an invented scale.

submission_probability_by_attack_share.definition: attack share = the fraction of a role's own attempt weight that is a direct submission attempt, plus (x0.7) chains landing on a submission-control platform. Passes into a pin deliberately do NOT count: the corpus prices submission_probability as the threat FROM this position, which is why every settled passing top authors 5-20.

house_scale_derived_from_the_corpus.asymmetric_file_gap: In the 71 settled files that word one role offensive and the other defensive, the offensive side leads by a median of +36 submission / +26 retention / +26 advancement, and trails on any of the three in only 2-4 files. Several files in scope ran that gap at exactly 0/0/0 — the same numbers on both sides of an asymmetric position.

what_was_deliberately_not_done: No mass rescaling. 45 of the 65 roles examined were left untouched because their numbers sit inside the corpus's own bands and their small strength is a property of the FORMULA, not of broken data.

The gate was never the target. Metrics were not nudged to flip a sign: Williams Guard Bottom keeps correct metrics and stays a live warning precisely because the honest answer there is a word question.

headline_measurement.statement: The defect the panel named is measurable: the 65 roles in scope carried a median |strength| of 0.056 against 0.244 for the settled corpus — 4.4x flatter. Whatever their real character (a heel-hook platform, a submission control, a scrambly guard) they all read as mush.
headline_measurement.cause: A handful of stock triplets were copy-pasted across unrelated files: 42/60/60 appears on 11 role-nodes (8 of them in scope, all leg entanglements), 38/68/62 on 5, 42/68/62 on 3.
headline_measurement.after: median |strength| of the 20 recalibrated roles: 0.056 -> 0.086; whole corpus 0.156 -> 0.172. The wave was NOT a rescaling: 45 of the 65 roles examined were left exactly as authored.

open_for_owner.item: Williams Guard Bottom — the one remaining position_type warning
open_for_owner.finding: Its metrics are right and its WORD is the open question, so nothing was changed. Every one of its six transitions is an attack (Williams shoulder lock 20%, triangle setup 26%, belly-down armbar 11%, omoplata sweep, back take, sweep), 31% of its hand is a direct finish, and its own invariants describe holding the opponent's arm in a shoulder lock creating 'constant submission threat'. submission_probability 52 sits mid-band for that attack share. Yet the file words BOTH roles defensively — bottom 'Defensive with offensive options', top 'Defensive' — so it claims nobody is attacking, and the bottom's honest numbers therefore disagree with its own label.
open_for_owner.recommendation: Owner call: re-word Williams Guard Bottom to 'Offensive' or 'Offensive/Controlling'. NOT changed here — words are the panel's and the owner's.
open_for_owner.if_accepted: the warning clears with no metric change at all.

open_for_owner.item: Two of the ten v1.106.3 spot fixes silently did nothing
open_for_owner.finding: Open Guard Top and Standing Guard Top were changed from risk_level 'Medium' to 'Low to Medium' to drop risk one notch. score_graph_nodes.risk_penalty() only knows low/medium/high/none and maps anything else to the medium default of 0.25 — so 'Low to Medium' scores identically to 'Medium' and neither position moved. 71 of 272 role-nodes (26%) use such compound risk strings ('Low to Medium' 47, 'Medium to High' 24), so a quarter of the corpus cannot express risk at all.
open_for_owner.recommendation: Either teach risk_penalty the compound vocabulary (blast radius: 71 role-nodes change strength at once) or normalise the content to the four canonical words. Not done here — both touch positions outside this wave's scope.

open_for_owner.item: Magnitude is bounded by point_value, which guards can never carry
open_for_owner.finding: point_value is IBJJF scoring: 241 of 272 role-nodes author 0, and only pins (mount/back +/-4, side control +/-3, knee-on-belly 2) carry anything. At point_value 0 with Medium risk the formula's reach is about -0.30..+0.22, so a fully-calibrated leg entanglement still reads weaker than a mediocre pin. Backside 50-50 Top, recalibrated here to 56/68/66, reaches only +0.078. Content calibration cannot fix this.
open_for_owner.recommendation: If the owner wants submission platforms to read as strong as pins, that is a scoring change (a submission-platform term, or letting risk_level 'Low' do more work), not a content change. Flagged, not attempted.

open_for_owner.item: The same stock-triplet defect exists outside this wave's scope
open_for_owner.finding: Honey Hole Top — the saddle, the strongest leg entanglement in the game — carries the stock 42/60/60 while 72% of its hand is a direct finish, and the corpus's own Saddle Top authors 70/78/75 for the same position. It was not in the panel's 73 and so was not touched. Reverse Scarf Hold Top (42/60/60, 44% direct finishes) and 50-50 Guard Top (owner-ruled Neutral) share the fingerprint.
open_for_owner.recommendation: A short follow-up pass on the ~8 platforms carrying stock triplets outside the adjudicated list.

what_this_wave_learned.the trough: THE DISPLAYED STRENGTH IS |bare|, SO IMPROVING A METRIC CAN MAKE A POSITION READ WEAKER. Since v1.103.0 the authored word sets the sign and the formula supplies only the magnitude, so for an offensively-worded role whose arithmetic is NEGATIVE, raising its metrics walks the score toward zero before it climbs again — a V, not a ramp. Two roles landed in that trough on the first pass and were caught by a second: Outside Ashi-Garami Bottom shipped +0.002 (a heel-hook platform reading as a position with no character) and Diamond Guard Bottom +0.005, BELOW the plain Closed Guard Bottom it is an upgrade on. Anyone calibrating these numbers must check the shipped strength, not just the authored value — and must check ORDER against settled peers, which is what caught both.
what_this_wave_learned.ordering is the real contract: score_graph_nodes' own acceptance test is a list of ORDERING invariants, not magnitudes, and that is the right frame at point_value 0. Ten BJJ orderings were asserted after this wave (leg-entanglement hierarchy outside < inside < cross < saddle; the trapped side of inside ashi worse than outside ashi; diamond guard better than closed guard for the guard player and worse for the trapped one; both 50-50 sides now asymmetric; deep half top below deep half bottom) and all hold, as do the six invariants shipped in the scorer.
what_this_wave_learned.stock triplets are the fingerprint: The fastest way to find a broken position is not the score — it is a metric triplet that appears verbatim on unrelated files. 42/60/60 on 11 role-nodes, 38/68/62 on 5, 42/68/62 on 3. Six files in the whole corpus carry IDENTICAL values on both of their roles; four are legitimately symmetric (Clinch, Dogfight, Standing, Leg Entanglement — all worded Neutral) and the two that were not (Backside 50-50, Diamond Guard) are both fixed here.
